description: This file defines interfaces, configurations, and factory functions for upper PHY processing components in a 5G NR software stack, including uplink/downlink processor factories, PHY layer configurations, and symbol handler factories.

classes.name: uplink_processor_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating uplink processors and validators.

classes.name: downlink_processor_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating downlink processors and validators.

classes.name: pdsch_processor_generic_configuration
classes.description: Configuration parameters for generic PDSCH processing.

classes.name: pdsch_processor_flexible_configuration
classes.description: Configuration parameters for flexible PDSCH processing, including batch length.

classes.name: downlink_processor_factory_sw_config
classes.description: Software factory configuration for downlink processing, including encoder and CRC types.

classes.name: downlink_processor_factory_sw_dependencies
classes.description: Dependencies for creating a software downlink processor factory.

classes.name: upper_phy_configuration
classes.description: Parameters for creating an upper PHY instance, including ports, resource grids, and buffer configs.

classes.name: upper_phy_dependencies
classes.description: Dependencies required for creating an upper PHY, such as resource grid gateway and symbol notifier.

classes.name: upper_phy_factory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating upper PHY objects.

classes.name: upper_phy_factory_configuration
classes.description: Configuration parameters for upper PHY factory, including logging, metrics, and LDPC settings.

classes.name: upper_phy_rx_symbol_handler_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating upper PHY receive symbol handlers.

classes.name: phy_tap_factory
classes.description: Interface for creating PHY tap plugins.

methods.name: create_uplink_processor_pool
methods.description: Creates a pool of uplink processors based on configuration.

methods.name: create_dl_processor_pool
methods.description: Creates a pool of downlink processors based on configuration.

methods.name: create_downlink_processor_factory_sw
methods.description: Creates a software-based downlink processor factory with specified config and dependencies.

methods.name: create_upper_phy_factory
methods.description: Creates an upper PHY factory with given configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: create_rx_symbol_handler_factory
methods.description: Creates a factory for upper PHY receive symbol handlers.

methods.name: create_rx_symbol_handler_printer_decorator_factory
methods.description: Creates a decorator factory for printing received symbols.

methods.name: create_phy_tap_factory
methods.description: Creates a PHY tap factory with specified parameters.
